results.title: Beloved Emma
results.overview: Student couple Vin and Viki cannot take care of their daughter because they have nowhere to live. Vin brings an iPhone from somewhere so they can send their daughter Ema a few messages. Professor Ema reports the theft of her cell phone, and new videos begin to appear on her computer...

results.title: Bloody Mary
results.overview: After stuttering while ordering his favorite drink while on a bad date, Trevor gets more than he asked for.

results.title: Midna
results.overview: At a traditional bowling alley in Mar del Plata, Midna is dumped by her girlfriend Dani through a voice message. This triggers in her an episode of anger and violence.

results.title: Jade
results.overview: Jade presents the story of a woman who comes between a powerful businessman and a gang leader in their search for a hard drive that could damage the operations of Interpol. Despite grieving for the brother she accidentally killed, the woman is required to use her unique set of skills to retrieve the drive and protect her brother's unborn child being carried by another woman.

results.title: The Green Dinosaur
results.overview: When the world around him is mysteriously erased, a little green dinosaur named Diplodocus must travel through the pages of a comic book and adventure through time to bring color back to his land. Alongside a wizard and two scientists, Diplo’s plans go awry as he learns that there may be a dimension to his world that he never considered.

results.title: Out of My Mind
results.overview: Melody Brooks, a sixth grader with cerebral palsy, has a quick wit and a sharp mind, but because she is non-verbal and uses a wheelchair, she is not given the same opportunities as her classmates. When a young educator notices her student's untapped potential and Melody starts to participate in mainstream education, Melody shows that what she has to say is more important than how she says it.

results.title: A Sudden Case of Christmas
results.overview: An American couple bring their 10 year old daughter, Claire, to her grandfather Lawrence's hotel in The Dolomites, Italy. They usually come for Christmas but this year it’s August. The fact is they are breaking up, and once Claire realizes there’s not going to be a family Christmas this year, she insists on everyone making it out for Christmas in August. Claire, in collusion with her grandfather, plan activities that are designed to re-unite her parents.

results.title: Pick One
results.overview: A multiracial 2nd grader finds himself in a crisis of identity when a big test at school asks for him to "pick one" race/ethnicity.

results.title: Midas Man (La historia de Brian Epstein)
results.original_title: Midas Man (La historia de Brian Epstein)
results.overview: When Brian Epstein set foot in the Cavern Club in November 1961 to watch The Beatles perform, he saw something no one else could – a glimmer of gold. Sharply dressed and well-spoken, Brian was hardly the most obvious radical – but being Jewish, closeted and having grown up as an outsider who had failed at pretty much everything, he was a 26-year old with something to prove and who wanted to tear up the rulebook.

results.title: Mind Games
results.overview: A date gone awry. Two lonely people meet at a hotel in a desperate attempt to find love. Neither get what they expect.

results.title: Twin Flame
results.overview: When tragedy occurs, young Thomas is tasked with delivering punishment, aided by a connection which blurs the line between the living and dead.

results.title: Into The Mortal World
results.overview: The classic legend is adapted, and the descendants of the Cowherd and the Weaving Maiden continue to write a new adventure!  The twenty-eight star constellations contain the power of the stars, which can destroy the sky and the earth. However, the Weaving Maiden, who is in charge of the Starry Nights, is greedy for the mortal world, causing the Starry Nights to flee and causing trouble. Years later, the Weaving Maiden's son, Jin Feng, went down to the world for his mother, and teamed up with a young girl, Xiaofan, to subdue the Starry Nights. People and gods together, all the way to the thrills and dangers, the mystery of Xiaofan's life, the truth of the Weaving Maiden's crime also gradually surfaced .....

results.title: A Cabana
results.overview: A woman and a man live their life together in a vague manner, absent and mechanical in the cloud that surrounds them. A couple who cannot see each other. Till when?

results.title: Rich Flu
results.overview: A strange disease kills off some of the richest and most influential people on the planet. First it was the billionaires, then the multi-millionaires and so on progressively... Then it threatens to strike anyone with any sort of fortune. With the whole world panicking, people try to flood the market with assets the world no longer wants.

results.title: Night Crawl
results.overview: Sleep is such a vulnerable state, it requires a complete letting go of control. Slipping out of waking consciousness into another world. A world controlled by an unpredictable subconscious that loves to play tricks on you. Watching someone fall asleep is to see them move through different states of being, exposed and unaware.

results.title: Mi prima la sexóloga 2 (de la fantasía a la realidad)
results.original_title: Mi prima la sexóloga 2 (de la fantasía a la realidad)
results.overview: After six months of dating, Malena and Manuel decide it's time to move to the next level and create a Cousins Club where members will learn about sex.

results.title: The Thicket
results.overview: An innocent young man, Jack, goes on an epic quest to rescue his sister Lula after she has been kidnapped by the violent killer Cut Throat Bill and her gang. To save her, Jack enlists the help of a crafty bounty hunter named Reginald Jones, a grave-digging alcoholic son of an ex-slave, and a street-smart prostitute. The gang tracks Cut Throat Bill into the deadly no-man’s land known as The Big Thicket — a place where blood and chaos reign.

results.title: Noche Oscura
results.overview: A young street kid criminal lies half dead in an alleyway, knocking on death's door. He's approached by a devilish figure who gives him a choice. Get jammed full of experimental cybernetics to save his life - but become property of the police department, or die. Quickly rising through the ranks, JC Howell becomes one of the best detectives on the force, despite his young age. While investigating a bizarre murder, an old enemy is revealed, sending him on a quest for revenge.

results.title: Moving Mission
results.overview: Two aliens arrive on a post-apocalyptic planet Earth in the year 2030. They will embark on an adventure to discover if the conditions of the planet are suitable for their race to move to such a place.

results.title: Music by John Williams
results.overview: His unforgettable scores are an essential part of some of the most beloved movies of our time, over a career that spans decades. See and hear maestro John Williams' own story, with insights from filmmakers, musicians, and others he has inspired, complete with rare behind-the-scenes looks at the making of movie history.
